companyCategories.description: Filter companies by category (e.g. 'saas', 'fintech'). Case-insensitive substring match on startup name/slug.
companyCategories.title: Company Category Filter

experience.description: Filter by experience level (matches on job title/description keywords).
experience.title: Experience Level

includeNoSalary.description: When false, jobs with no compensation field are filtered out.
includeNoSalary.title: Include Jobs Without Salary Data

jobTitle.description: Client-side filter: only jobs whose title contains this phrase (case-insensitive).
jobTitle.title: Job Title Filter

jobType.description: Filter by employment type (matches on job metadata/description).
jobType.title: Job Type

keyword.description: Client-side keyword filter across title + company + location (case-insensitive).
keyword.title: Keyword

location.description: Client-side location filter (case-insensitive match on any location name).
location.title: Location Filter

minSalary.description: Minimum annual compensation parsed from job compensation field.
minSalary.title: Minimum Salary (USD/year)

remoteOnly.description: Return only jobs flagged as remote.
remoteOnly.title: Remote Only

startUrls.description: Wellfound URLs. Default is https://wellfound.com/jobs. Supports ?remote=true and other query params. /role/l/ deep-filter URLs require residential proxy (escalated automatically).
startUrls.title: Start URLs
